seamOffsetNote: Median of (shell - core) over open ground in a 900 m ring inside the core boundary (3128 of 10252 ring cells). Open ground is isolated because the shell is a SURFACE model and the core is bare earth: over all cells the median is +4.37 m, but that figure is canopy height, which is a genuine difference in what the two datasets measure rather than an error. What remains on open ground is the systematic part - the EGM2008 vs DHHN2016 datum difference - and only that is removed globally. It is a seam alignment, not a geodetic datum determination, and must not be cited as one.
verticalDatum: shifted onto the core's DHHN2016 by the measured seam offset
